title: He Kept Reading During Vesuvius
aria: Animated stick-figure short about Pliny the Younger during the eruption of Vesuvius in AD 79
foot: Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Music and effects are synthesized or CC0. Events follow Pliny the Younger's letters 6.16 and 6.20 to Tacitus; expressions, poses, rooms and the red cloak are illustration.
